'$'''cat <<-'''EVAL_HEREDOC'''
{
 for i in {1..2}, do
 ( recursive_bg 2 ) &
 done
} | tee >(cat >&2) >/dev/null &
EVAL_HEREDOC
' (3,133 us, 0.03%)

'$'''cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do
 ( eval "echo NESTED-${depth}-\$i" ) &
done
wait
NESTED
' (1,022 us, 0.01%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT, @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 1' (30,178 us, 0.32%)
'@TRAP (EXIT): echo "EXIT $depth"\, trap "echo NESTED_EXIT $depth" EXIT, @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 3' (30,064 us, 0.32%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1_HANDLER"\, trap "echo USR1_NESTED" USR1, @TRAP (RETURN): echo NESTED_RETURN 0' (37,669 us, 0.40%)

'$'''eval "$(cat <<-'''NESTED'''
for ((i=0, i<2, i++)), do

done

NESTED
